howToExport: In Wise, open the currency balance you want to import and go to its statements.
Choose the period and CSV as the file type; business accounts may add extra columns, which the preset ignores.
Download one file per currency balance and drop it above.
knownQuirks: Every row carries conversion metadata (Exchange From, Exchange To, Exchange Rate) that QuickBooks' 3-column upload can't take; it is dropped.
The counterparty sits in a different column depending on direction: Payee Name for money out, Payer Name for money in, Merchant for card spend. The preset reads whichever is filled on each row.
Wise's Description («Card transaction of 18.40 GBP issued by…») repeats the amount; counterparty plus payment reference makes a steadier QuickBooks description, with the original as fallback.
Each statement covers one currency balance, so it belongs in a QuickBooks account in that same currency.

columnMapping.transformationNote: First non-empty counterparty on each row
